sam k: Heads-up: nova-13b-int3 staging rerank harness shows a ~7% regression vs prod on control. Suspects: tokenization normalization and noisy near-duplicates. Can we triage quick? @li zhang @anya
li zhang: Starting dedupe with tokenwalk-v2 at 0.95 threshold. Will output a deduped control slice to s3. ETA ~20m.
anya: I'll diff tokenizer maps between main and nova-13b-int3. Already seeing NFKC & dash differences. Will create a compat normalize layer and re-tokenize a small sample.
matt_g: Spinning a tiny smoke pool to run paired evals (fp32 vs int3) on deduped slice. Ready in ~10m.
labelops-bot: relabel job queued by matt_g  job_id=9880, samples=1500, priority=high.
li zhang: Dedupe done: removed 3.0% (mostly punctuation-only variants). Saved deduped path and short-variants for manual review.
anya: Applied compat layer (NFKC + dash normalization + strip zws). Token-length distribution now matches prod within 0.5% MAE.
matt_g: Ran paired smoke: mean_rerank_delta = -1.0%, median = -0.3%, 98th pct = -7.0%. Top diffs concentrated on ~90 samples. Uploaded per-sample diffs.
li zhang: Quick triage: 35 samples show token-boundary shifts, 25 look like paraphrase/annotation edgecases, rest appear model-behavior deltas.
sam k: Plan: 1) labelops finish relabel for 25 paraphrase samples, 2) ops to run focused quant-kernel tweak on 35 token-shift samples, 3) ML to investigate remaining deltas. Keep this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
